cards.text:
混沌教派
阵营规则
诅咒之礼
在神灵的赐福下，被混沌诅咒的追随者们遭
受了一系列可怕的变异。蝙蝠之翼、锋利脊
角、邪恶利爪，还有灵活触须：这些邪恶的
馈赠都能够被用在毁灭之上。
诅咒之礼是在己方混沌教派特工转变成为另一
个特工类型时获得的规则（参见“变异”阵营规
则）。当首次有一名己方虔信者特工在战斗中变
为变异者特工时，选择您的第一诅咒之礼。当首
次有一名己方变异者特工在战斗中变为受难者特
工时，选择您的第二诅咒之礼。
所有己方变异者特工都将拥有您选择的第一诅咒
之礼，所有己方受难者特工都将拥有您选择的第
一和第二诅咒之礼。在每场战斗中，您不能多次
选择同样的诅咒之礼。
诅咒之礼选项将在单独的卡片上分别展示
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION RULE
ACCURSED GIFTS
Accursed followers of Chaos are blessed by the gods
with a horrifying array of mutations. Chiropteran wings,
rigid horns, wicked claws and dextrous tentacles: all of
these diabolical gifts are used to devastating effect.
ACCURSED GIFTS are rules that friendly CHAOS
CULT operatives gain when they turn into
another operative type (see Mutation faction
rule). The first time a friendly DEVOTEE operative
turns into a MUTANT operative during the battle,
select your primary ACCURSED GIFT. The first
time a friendly MUTANT operative turns into a
TORMENT operative during the battle, select your
secondary ACCURSED GIFT.
All friendly MUTANT operatives have your primary
ACCURSED GIFT, and all friendly TORMENT
operatives have your primary and secondary
ACCURSED GIFTS. You cannot select the same
ACCURSED GIFT more than once per battle.
ACCURSED GIFT OPTIONS ARE PRESENTED ON
THEIR OWN CARDS

cards.text:
混沌教派
阵营规则
诅咒之礼
1. 生翼
残破的巨大翅膀从血肉中生长而出。这些邪
恶的变异能够让扭曲之物以惊人的敏捷上下
移动。
在该特工进行向上攀爬时，您可以将垂直距离视
作 2"（无论特工实际移动的垂直距离是多少)。
每当该特工进行跳落时，无视垂直距离。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION RULE
ACCURSED GIFTS
1. Deformed Wings
Tattered, leathery wings burst from heaving folds of
flesh. These infernal mutations allow their wretched
bearer to ascend and drop into the fray with
terrifying agility.
Whenever this operative is climbing up, you can
treat the vertical distance as 2" (regardless of
how far the operative actually moves vertically).
Whenever this operative is dropping, ignore the
vertical distance.

cards.text:
混沌教派
阵营规则
诅咒之礼
2. 迅捷
粗壮的畸形肢体、抽动的触须和沾满黏液的
器官让变异的混沌信徒以惊人且可怕的速度
在战场上穿梭。
该特工的移动属性增加 1"。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION RULE
ACCURSED GIFTS
2. Fleet
Muscular, misshapen limbs, undulating tentacles and
slime-slick extrusions propel mutant Cultists across
the battlefield with a speed that is as shocking as it
is horrific.
Add 1" to this operative’s Move stat.

cards.text:

几丁质和恶魔之力构成的坚固硬壳从教徒的

cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT

ACCURSED GIFTS
3. Chitinous
Hardened plates formed of chitinous, daemonic material
erupt from angry, swollen flesh, lending the accursed

Improve this operative’s Save stat by 1.

cards.text:

4. 犄角
一对尖锐的犄角从变异教徒的头部钻出，能
够被用来冲撞和穿刺敌人。
在该特工结束冲锋行动的移动时，您可以对一名
位于其控制范围内的敌方特工造成 1 点伤害，如

cards.text_en:

FACTION RULE
ACCURSED GIFTS
4. Horned
Pairs of sharp, curved horns protrude from the
foreheads of some mutant Cultists, used to charge, gore
and impale their victims.
Whenever this operative ends its move during the
Charge action, you can inflict 1 damage on one
enemy operative within its control range, or D3

cards.text:

阵营规则

强韧的筋腱包裹着这名扭曲教徒的肌肉，让
其能够以怪物一般的力量发动攻击。
您可以忽略该特工因受创而导致的任何对近战武

暴”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION RULE
ACCURSED GIFTS
5. Sinewed
Within this Cultist’s twisted form, hardened sinews and
tendons bind muscle, lending monstrous strength to
each and every strike they make.
You can ignore any changes to the Hit stat of this
operative’s melee weapons from being injured.
This operative’s melee weapons have the Brutal
weapon rule.

cards.text:
混沌教派
阵营规则
诅咒之礼
6. 带刺
这位教徒的身体和武器上都遍布着尖锐的倒
刺，在攻击时能够撕裂敌人血肉。
每当该特工进行近战或反击时：
• 敌方特工不能协助。
• 每当您在那个流程中首次出击时，对该特工
控制范围内的每一个其他敌方特工造成 1 点
伤害，如果该特工是受难者，则造成 D3 点
伤害（对每个特工分别掷骰）。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION RULE
ACCURSED GIFTS
6. Barbed
This Cultist’s body and weapons are coated with sharp
barbs that bite into those nearby, ripping flesh and
spilling blood.
Whenever this operative is fighting or retaliating:
• Enemy operatives cannot assist.
• The first time you strike during that sequence,
also inflict 1 damage on each other enemy
operative within this operative’s control range,
or D3 damage instead if this operative is a
TORMENT (roll separately for each).

cards.text:
混沌教派
阵营规则
变异
通过神秘的仪式，最为热诚的混沌信徒会在
自己的身上刻下不洁的印记或者刺青。如果
说出了正确的咒语，那么这些魔印就会吸引
亚空间的力量，产生变异。对一些人来说，
这并不能满足他们的黑暗欲望。堕落的祷文
会被书写在人皮之上并钉入血肉之中，将召
唤而来的恶魔束缚在凡人的躯壳内。
在战斗期间，己方混沌教派特工可以通过以下
方式进行变异：
• 作为一个战略计划，您可以将一定数量的己方
混沌教派特工进行变异，具体的数量如下：
第一转折点 2 个，第二转折点 2 个，第三转折
点 3 个，第四及之后的转折点 4 个。
• 每当一名虔信者特工将其控制范围内的敌方特
工残废时，该特工可以进行变异。
• 在每个转折点中，每一名特工变异的次数不能
超过一次。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION RULE
MUTATION
Through arcane ritual, the most devoted among a
Chaos Cult have profane symbols carved into their
flesh or tattooed onto their skin. Should the correct
words of invocation be uttered, these icons appear to
draw empyric power, mutating the form of the devotee.
This doesn’t satisfy the dark cravings and power lust
of some; depraved prayers are written upon flayed
skin and nailed into tormented flesh, and daemons are
summoned and bound into mortal bodies.
During the battle, friendly CHAOS CULT
operatives can MUTATE as follows:
• As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT, you can MUTATE a
number of friendly CHAOS CULT operatives
based on the turning point as follows: TP1 = 2,
TP2 = 2, TP3 = 3, TP4+ = 4.
• Whenever a friendly DEVOTEE operative
incapacitates an enemy operative within its
control range, it can MUTATE.
• Each operative cannot MUTATE more than
once per turning point.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
每当一名己方特工进行变异时，选择以下一个
效果：
• 如果是一名虔信者特工，那么该特工转变成一
名变异者特工。
• 如果是一名变异者特工，那么该特工转变成一
名受难者特工（每个转折点最多两次）。
• 特工回复最多 D3+1 点失去的耐伤。
您不能同时拥有超过 5 名变异者特工和 3 名受难
者特工。
每当一名己方特工转变成新的特工时：
• 更换特工的微缩模型，确保新模型底座的中心
尽可能靠近原本模型底座中心的位置。这可能
会导致特工被放置在敌方特工的控制范围内，
并且如果原本的模型已经位于敌方特工的控制
范围内，那么如果可能，新的模型也必须位于
那些敌方特工的控制范围内。
• 新的特工类型失去一定数量的耐伤，数值等同
于它之前的特工类型失去的耐伤。
• 如果特工在之前被任何规则效果选中，那么该
特工依旧算作是同一名特工。转变后的特工单
纯属于新的特工类型，使用新的微缩模型以及
数据卡规则。
cards.text_en:
Whenever a friendly operative MUTATES, select
one of the following:
• If it’s a DEVOTEE operative, turn it into a
MUTANT operative.
• If it’s a MUTANT operative, turn it into
a TORMENT operative (max twice per
turning point).
• It can regain up to D3+1 lost wounds.
You cannot have more than five MUTANT
operatives and three TORMENT operatives at
once. Whenever a friendly operative turns into a
new operative:
• Swap the miniatures, ensuring the centre of the
new miniature’s base is as close as possible to
where the centre of the old miniature’s base
was. This can put it within control range of
enemy operatives, and if the old miniature was,
the new miniature must be if possible.
• The new operative type loses a number
of wounds equal to the lost wounds of its
preceding operative type.
• It’s still the same operative for any rules it’s
already been selected for. The operative is
simply a new operative type and will use that
new type’s miniature and datacard rules.

cards.text:
混沌教派
战略计谋
痛苦之乐
在狂热信仰的驱使下，狂乱的教徒们享受着自
己的变异肉体所受到的绝佳痛苦。
您可以忽略己方混沌教派特工由于处于受创状
态而导致的武器命中属性的变化。每当一名特工
对一名受伤的己方混沌教派特工进行射击时，
您可以重掷一枚自己的防御骰。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
STRATEGY PLOY
EXALTATION IN PAIN
Spurred on by their fervour, Cultists embrace the
exquisite agony of wounds upon their mutant flesh with
maniacal delight.
You can ignore any changes to the Hit stat of
friendly CHAOS CULT operatives’ weapons
from being injured. Whenever an operative is
shooting a friendly CHAOS CULT operative
that’s wounded, you can re-roll one of your
defence dice.

cards.text:
混沌教派
战略计谋
狂热猛攻
为了换取冷酷神明的些许祝福，迷失者与受诅
咒者会热忱且急迫地进行战斗。
己方混沌教派特工的近战武器拥有“精准 1”
武器规则，如果受影响的特工是一名变异者或受
难者特工，则那名特工的近战武器获得‘精准
2’武器规则。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
STRATEGY PLOY
FERVENT ONSLAUGHT
The lost and the damned fight with a zealous
desperation to earn the fickle favour of their
uncaring patrons.
Friendly CHAOS CULT operatives’ melee
weapons have the Accurate 1 weapon rule, or the
Accurate 2 weapon rule if that friendly operative
is a MUTANT or TORMENT operative.

cards.text:
混沌教派
战略计谋
噩梦生物
这些诅咒之物的扭曲姿态会唤起绝望的恐惧。
在判断对一个标识的控制权时，如果有至少一名
争夺标识的敌方特工位于己方混沌教派变异者
或混沌教派受难者特工的 2" 内，那么将争夺标
识的敌方特工的 APL 属性总和视作为比原本低 1
点。请注意，这不是对 APL 属性的修改，因此
任何修改效果会与本规则的效果叠加。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
STRATEGY PLOY
CREATURES OF NIGHTMARE
The twisted and unnatural forms of these accursed
monstrosities inspire abject terror.
Whenever determining control of a marker,
treat the total APL stat of enemy operatives that
contest it as 1 lower if at least one of those enemy
operatives is within 2" of friendly CHAOS CULT
MUTANT or CHAOS CULT TORMENT operatives.
Note this isn’t a change to the APL stat, so any
changes are cumulative with this.

cards.text:
混沌教派
战略计谋
恶心气场
变异者和受难者的身上散发着令人不适的腐化
气息，消磨着周边敌人的理智与力量。
当敌方特工位于己方混沌教派变异者或混沌教
派受难者特工 2" 内时，其武器的命中属性弱化
1。本规则的效果不能与受创规则的效果叠加。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
STRATEGY PLOY
SICKENING AURA
Sickening corruption flows from the hideous form of
Mutant and Torment, eroding the sanity and strength of
those who gaze upon them.
Whenever an enemy operative is within 2" of
friendly CHAOS CULT MUTANT or CHAOS CULT
TORMENT operatives, worsen the Hit stat of
that enemy operative’s weapons by 1. This isn’t
cumulative with being injured.

cards.text:
混沌教派
交战计谋
忠诚追随者
混沌教派人数无穷无尽，每一位教徒都愿意
为保护自己的不洁领袖而献身。
在一名己方混沌教派黑暗秘社特工被选择成为
一次射击行动的有效目标或者近战行动的近战对
象时使用本交战计谋。选择另一名位于该特工
3" 内且可见的己方混沌教派特工（黑暗秘社除
外）来替代作为那次射击的有效目标或近战对象
（视情况而定)，就算特工通常不能成为有效目
标。如果这是一次近战行动，那么在这次行动
期间将被选择的特工视作为位于近战特工的控
制范围内。如果进行的是一次射击行动，那么
其他特工只有在原本目标拥有掩护或被遮挡时
才能拥有对应的效果。
本规则对使用带有“爆炸”或者“洪流”武器规
则的武器所进行的射击行动无效。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
FAITHFUL FOLLOWER
The teeming masses of a Chaos Cult will gladly
sacrifice their own wretched lives to preserve their
unholy superiors.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly CHAOS
CULT DARK COMMUNE operative is selected
as the valid target of a Shoot action or to fight
against during the Fight action. Select one other
friendly CHAOS CULT operative (excluding DARK
COMMUNE) visible to and within 3" of that DARK
COMMUNE operative to become the valid target
or to be fought against (as appropriate) instead
(even if it wouldn’t normally be valid for this). If
it’s the Fight action, treat that other operative as
being within the fighting operative’s control range
for the duration of that action. If it’s the Shoot
action, that other operative is only in cover or
obscured if the original target was.
This ploy has no effect if it’s the Shoot action
and the ranged weapon has the Blast or Torrent
weapon rule.

cards.text:
混沌教派
交战计谋
憎恶突变
在战斗之中充斥着各种暴力与情绪，湮灭之
力会将诅咒之礼赋予手下的信徒。
在一名己方混沌教派特工（黑暗秘社除外）被
激活时使用本交战计谋。选择一个诅咒之礼，那
名特工获得对应的效果。这个效果会与特工已经
拥有的任何诅咒之礼的效果叠加。在每场战斗
中，每一名己方特工只能被选择成为本计谋的对
象一次，并且如果那名特工变成了另一种类型的
特工（参见“变异”阵营规则)，它依旧拥有通
过本计谋选择的诅咒之礼。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ABHORRENT MUTATION
In the midst of battle, when violence and emotion
run rampant, the Ruinous Powers bestow upon their
underlings their accursed gifts.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly CHAOS
CULT operative (excluding DARK COMMUNE)
is activated. Select an ACCURSED GIFT for
that operative to gain. This is in addition to any
ACCURSED GIFTS it already has. Each friendly
operative cannot be selected for this ploy more
than once per battle, and if that operative turns
into a different one (see Mutation faction rule), it
still has that ACCURSED GIFT.

cards.text:
混沌教派
交战计谋
狂热死亡
就算在死亡之时，黑暗诸神的信徒们也会想
尽办法制造痛苦与破坏。
在一名己方混沌教派变异者或混沌教派受难
者特工被残废时，在将其移出杀戮区域前使用本
交战计谋。对那名特工 2"内的一名可见敌方特工
造成 D3 点伤害（如果己方特工是受难者特工，
则造成 D6 点伤害)。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
FRENZIED DEMISE
Even in their death throes, the devotees of the Dark
Gods seek to inflict agony and destruction.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly CHAOS
CULT MUTANT or CHAOS CULT TORMENT
operative is incapacitated, before it’s removed
from the killzone. Inflict D3 damage (or D6
damage instead if that friendly operative is a
TORMENT) on one enemy operative visible to and
within 2" of that friendly operative.

cards.text:
混沌教派
交战计谋
释放恶魔
在不断升级的暴力之中，现实空间逐渐变得
支离破碎，而恶魔之力则变得愈加强大。
在一名己方混沌教派变异者或混沌教派受难
者特工的激活期间执行任何行动之前或之后使用
本交战计谋。在那次激活中，那名特工可以执行
两次近战行动，并且其中一次可以是无消耗的
行动。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
UNLEASH THE DAEMON
Amidst escalating violence, the veil of reality is torn
asunder and the influence of the daemonic strengthens.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly CHAOS
CULT MUTANT or CHAOS CULT TORMENT
operative’s activation, before or after it performs
an action. During that activation, that operative
can perform two Fight actions, and one of them
can be free.

cards.text:
混沌教派
阵营装备
邪恶魔典
这些邪恶的文字被书写在了人皮制成的书页
上，在使用黑暗之语进行朗诵后能够赐予阅
读者恐怖的赠礼。
每场战斗限一次，战略计划。更换您的一个诅咒
之礼。请注意，如果您选择了一个通过“憎恶突
变”交战计谋所获得的诅咒之礼，那么只有那
名受交战计谋效果影响的特工会获得变更后的
效果。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
BALEFUL SCRIPT
These infernal scrawlings, inscribed upon pages
wrought from Human flesh, may bestow malefic gifts
upon the reader when recited in the dark tongue.
Once per battle STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Change
one of your ACCURSED GIFTS. Note that if it's
an ACCURSED GIFT an operative has from the
Abhorrent Mutation firefight ploy, only that
operative benefits from this.

cards.text:
混沌教派
阵营装备
秘密伪装
最为狡诈的混沌教派擅长渗透、伪装和背叛。
在揭示了这个装备选项后，掷一枚 D3。在第一
转折点中，作为一个战略计划，相当于掷骰结
果数量且完全位于己方降落区内的己方混沌教派
虔信者特工可以立即执行一次无消耗的转移行
动，但是必须在完全位于己方降落区 3" 内的位
置结束那次移动。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COVERT GUISES
The most insidious of Chaos Cults are masters of
infiltration, disguise and betrayal.
After revealing this equipment option, roll one D3.
As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning point,
a number of friendly CHAOS CULT DEVOTEE
operatives equal to the result that are wholly
within your drop zone can immediately perform a
free Reposition action, but must end that move
wholly within 3" of your drop zone.

cards.text:
混沌教派
阵营装备
不洁护身符
无论是挂在残破的旗帜之上、雕刻在血肉之
中，还是垂挂在锁链上，混沌信徒们会将自
己的护身符展示出来，相信黑暗诸神会因此
而选中自己。
每个转折点限一次，在一名特工对己方混沌教派
特工进行射击时，在掷防御骰步骤中，您可以
将一枚普通成功作为关键成功保留。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
UNHOLY TALISMAN
Whether held aloft on ragged banners, carved into
puckered flesh or hanging from spiked chains, these
Cultists display talismans in the belief that the Dark
Gods will look favourably upon them.
Once per turning point, when an operative is
shooting a friendly CHAOS CULT operative,
in the Roll Defence Dice step, you can retain
one of your normal successes as a critical
success instead.

cards.text:
混沌教派
阵营装备
污秽祝福
虽然丑恶、骇人且十分痛苦，黑暗诸神所赐予
的变异能够让获得它们的人变得坚韧无比。
每场战斗限一次，在一枚攻击骰对一名己方混沌
教派特工（虔信者除外）造成普通伤害时，您
可以忽略那次伤害。如果那名己方特工是一名变
异者或受难者特工，那么您不能在进行了“超自
然再生”规则的掷骰之后再决定是否对同一枚骰
子使用本规则——您必须选择其中一个规则进行
使用。
cards.text_en:
CHAOS CULT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
VILE BLESSING
Though hideous, disturbing and often painful, the Dark
Gods’ gifts of mutation bestow upon their recipients
incredible resilience.
Once per battle, when an attack dice inflicts
Normal Dmg on a friendly CHAOS CULT
operative (excluding DEVOTEE), you can ignore
that inflicted damage. If that friendly operative
is a MUTANT or TORMENT operative, you cannot
roll for the Unnatural Regeneration rule for that
attack dice then decide to use this rule on the
same dice – you must use one or the other.
